title: tempdir is no longer maintained
summary: The tempdir crate has been deprecated and its functionality merged into tempfile.

constraints: Keep temporary directories cleaned up on drop, as before.

steps.title: Replace tempdir with tempfile
steps.instructions: Replace the tempdir dependency with tempfile and change `TempDir::new(prefix)` calls to `tempfile::tempdir()` or `tempfile::Builder`.

verification.purpose: Build and run the tests that create temporary directories.
